correctness.rationale: Complete trace coordinates (u,r) follow from only-marker commutations. A gap analysis gives necessary and sufficient marker bounds e(u)<=r<=m+1 for proper words and e_circ(u)<=r<=m for cyclic proper words, with u-empty and m=1 boundaries handled. Weighted path transitions give h(h-1+z)^(m-1); weighted closed-walk eigenvalues give (h-1+z)^m+(h-1)(z-1)^m. Exact finite geometric sums yield both formal rational generating functions; a^*b^* intersections prove both closures nonregular. The standalone checker agreed by original-word enumeration, gap enumeration and coefficient recurrences for h=2,3,4, and additional h<=7 cases. Finite checks do not establish the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an infinite exact count for a natural local constraint (adjacent unequal symbols) and its cyclic-boundary counterpart under partial commutation, serving as explicit benchmarks for trace-aware state-space reduction. Distinct all-alphabet rational enumerators are established while the corresponding trace closures are nonregular; it is more than a finite census, a trivial alphabet substitution, or a general algorithm restatement.
